item.title: Linux 7.0: One Bash Script, One Weekend, 23 Years of Kernel Bugs
item.description: Linux 7.0 shipped on April 12. One researcher found a 23-year-old NFSv4 vulnerability with a bash script and Claude over a weekend. Rust officially lost its 'experimental' tag. The kernel even grew three physical keys dedicated to AI agents. Here is what actually happened.
